title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Fee Schedule — First-Time and Second-Time Late Fees on Revolving Accounts
content:
The re-rated late fee of the most recent late fee on a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account is worked from the scheduled late fee. The scheduled late fee is set by the account's other late fees in the repeat window:

| Other late fees posted on the account in the repeat window | Account open | Scheduled late fee |
|---|---|---|
| None | At least 12 whole months | 25.00 (first-time late fee) |
| Exactly one | Any | 32.00 (second-time late fee) |
| Any other case — none with the account open less than 12 whole months, or two or more | | The tier's late fee: 39.00 on the Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge, 49.00 on the Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus (0.00 on the Commercial Account tiers, which carry no late fee) |

## Reading the record

- The other late fees are the late fees posted on the account within the repeat window, not counting the most recent late fee itself — the one being re-rated.
- The repeat window is counted back from the correction date in whole calendar months.
- Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the correction date.

## Cases (hypothetical, Pro Revolving Charge Plus)

| Late fees in the repeat window, the most recent included | Account open | Scheduled late fee |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 30 months | 25.00 |
| 1 | 8 months | 49.00 |
| 2 | 8 months | 32.00 |
| 3 | 30 months | 49.00 |
